ValidationRule.description: Monetary value must be populated if certain recovery types are selected
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Dollar_Value_Must_Be_Populated__c=TRUE, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Credit Card Refund'), ISBLANK(Monetary_Value__c) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'EFT Refund'), ISBLANK(Monetary_Value__c) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Flowers'), ISBLANK( Monetary_Value__c ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Dinner vouchers'), ISBLANK( Monetary_Value__c ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Travel vouchers'), ISBLANK( Monetary_Value__c ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Wine') , ISBLANK( Monetary_Value__c ) )))
